name: extracted-marker
description: Markers that have left through a drawpoint. They form their own list with their own IDs — a marker does not stay in `massflow.marker.list` after extraction — and carry the birth day, origin, mass and fragment size that recovery accounting is built from.
notes: Iterate with `loop foreach local m massflow.extractedmarker.list`.
`massflow.extractedmarker.mineblock` gives the block the material came from, which is what origin/destination reporting keys on.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.birthday
intrinsics.description: Get the day at which the extracted marker was formed

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.disp
intrinsics.description: v = massflow.extractedmarker.disp(mm) Get the extracted marker total accumulated displacement.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.extra
intrinsics.description: massflow.extractedmarker.extra(mm,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the extracted marker. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.find
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the extracted marker with internally assigned ID number i. If no marker exists with that ID number, then null is returned.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.fragment.diameter
intrinsics.description: Get the fragment diameter associated with this extracted marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.group
intrinsics.description: massflow.extractedmarker.group(mm,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to extracted marker mm in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.id
intrinsics.description: Get the ID of an extracted marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.list
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the container of all extracted markers in the model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.mass
intrinsics.description: Get the mass associated with this extractedmarker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.mineblock
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the original mineblock that contained a given extracted marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.num
intrinsics.description: Get the total number of extracted markers in the model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.origin
intrinsics.description: Get the the position of the extracted marker at the time it was created.

intrinsics.name: massflow.extractedmarker.type
intrinsics.description: Get the extracted marker type as an integer. The types are as follows: -2: unbulked for IMZ growth -1: unbulked for collapse 0: unbulked for rilling 1: partially bulked 2: fully bulked 3: air

live_verification: fish list intrinsics on live MassFlow 9.7.47 (build 6bc705b1eb), massflow.* only
